title: Impact of Australia Government's Land Acquisition Policy Change on SAF Training Space
what_it_is: Impact of Australia Government's Land Acquisition Policy Change on SAF Training Space

sections.label: Australian Defence training without land acquisition
sections.summary: The Australian Department of Defence stated it could meet Australian Defence Force and SAF training needs under the CSP without compulsory land acquisition, with costs within the CSP budget.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The Australian Department of Defence also stated publicly on 23 February 2017 that it would be able to achieve the training requirements for the Australian Defence Force and SAF under the terms of the CSP without compulsory land acquisition through enhancing existing training areas and a more optimal scheduling of training activities.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The costs of developments for SAF training requirements are still within the budget laid out in the CSP.
